exposure: gestational age at birth less than 38 weeks
outcome: length of hospital stay following caesarean section delivery
cohort: The study included 405 mothers who delivered by caesarean section at a government hospital in Northeast Ethiopia.
finding: The mean length of hospital stay after caesarean delivery was 2.8 days, and gestational age at birth less than 38 weeks, hypertension, and postoperative complications were significantly associated with a prolonged length of stay.
